article.title: A.I. System in Baltimore Schools Results in Police Abuse of Black Students
article.author: bareditors
article.content: A.I. System in Baltimore Schools Results in Police Abuse of Black Students Authors Black Agenda Radio with Margaret Kimberley bareditors Thu, 11/26/2026 - 06:27 The Lawyers’ Committee for Civil Rights Under Law filed a lawsuit against the Baltimore County Public Schools and the Baltimore County Police Department on behalf of four current and former students. The Omnilert A.I. system erroneously reported that a student's bag of chips was a gun. A system purporting to enhance safety instead brings the threat of police brutality to students in their schools. Len Kamdang, Director of the Criminal Justice Project at the Lawyers’ Committee for Civil Rights Under Law, explains the grounds for the lawsuit. African America A.I. Education Baltimore policing Police brutality
